title: Sound Exchange
blurb: Press a playlist into a battle creature. In battle, each creature rides the edge of its own spinning record: spin clockwise to strike as you pass the gap, counter-clockwise to block or parry. Moves are named after your songs and shouted like comic sound effects. Fill your hype, hit S, and tap to the beat.
controls: Scratch (drag around) your record or tap ⟳/⟲: clockwise attacks when you pass the gap, counter-clockwise into the gap as the rival strikes parries, holding still near the gap blocks. Arrow keys work too. At 100 hype press S (or the S key) and tap (or Space) on every beat.
